title: Identify female patients whose total protein (TP) is above the normal range
question: Identify female patients whose total protein (TP) is above the normal range and whose lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) is within the normal range. Among them, find the one with the highest IgA level within its normal range, and return her ID, age, and diagnosis.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
    p."XCL_058" AS id,
    l."XCL_016" AS age,
    p."XCL_064" AS diagnosis
FROM Patient AS p
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS l ON p."XCL_058" = l."XCL_014"
WHERE p."XCL_059" = 'F'
  AND l."XCL_020" > 8.5
  AND l."XCL_018" < 500
  AND l."XCL_043" BETWEEN 100 AND 400
ORDER BY l."XCL_043" DESC
LIMIT 1
